input.quote: 3.1 The Company shall pay HDI thirty percent (3016) of the Net Sales in excess of Eleven Thousand Dollars ($11,000) per calendar month.
input.rationale: Searches for MFN-style language ("most favored", "no less favorable", "favourable", "best", "price", "discount", "third party") return no most-favoured-nation construct anywhere in the Agreement. The Fees; Payment article (Sections 3.1–3.4) sets a fixed 30% revenue share on Net Sales with no obligation for the Company to extend HDI any terms given to third parties or to match third-party offers. The only "best terms" style provision is the Section 6.1 exclusivity covenant, which restricts the Company from participating in similar Internet projects and grants HDI exclusive use of the "Deerskin" brand online — that is a category/exclusivity restriction, not an MFN pricing obligation, and it is addressed under the exclusivity rule rather than duplicated here. This matches the preferred position: no MFN obligation burdens the Company. No redline required.
